title: Small talks - French with Anne
author: Anne Bernat
description: This podcast is about sharing small talks in French. Each podcast invites a different guest who shares my life in one way or another. It includes my family members, my friends and my students. The aim is to show that no matter what the accents and levels are, there is always a way to make ourselves be understood. Respect and open-mindedness are just the foundations. So let's get started!
